task.title: Completed Visible Abs photos -- real root cause found and fixed (corrects prior report)

result.summary: CORRECTS the prior report's item-3 conclusion. The Founder rechecked the Completed Visible Abs Goal photos on the existing, unmodified Build 63 and confirmed twice, reproducibly, that both Beginning and Completion still show a placeholder. Tracing one layer further than the prior audit found the real cause: every Native /api/v1/native/read/* response passes through a shared envelope() that runs projectNativeMediaReferences() over the whole body, which deletes any href/imageHref key holding a private-evidence media reference and replaces it with a differently-named media:{mediaId,deliveryPath} object. The server's composeCompletedGoalPreview genuinely produces a valid href, but the ACTUAL wire response Native receives never contains that href key at all -- only the renamed media object. Native's CompletedPhoto was still decoding the now-nonexistent href field, so mediaId always computed nil and the tile always fell back to placeholder, 100% reproducibly, independent of network conditions or database validity. Fixed by decoding the real media{mediaId,deliveryPath} shape instead -- the same shape ProductionDEXAAPI's sourceMedia and PhotosAPI's Prior.media already decode successfully today, not a new schema.

tests.summary: RED verified by actually running it: reverting only the Swift fix (keeping updated tests) made both remaining photo tests fail with nil where a real mediaId was expected, exactly reproducing the Founder's bug. GREEN verified by actually running it after reapplying: full PhysiqueOSTests target, 1445/1445 passing. Two existing tests updated to the real media{mediaId,deliveryPath} fixture shape (they were themselves built on the same wrong href assumption); one test covering URL query-string/fragment parsing deleted as structurally obsolete under the new shape.

review.summary: Independent fresh-context review verified the root-cause claim against the ACTUAL deployed production commit 2a23eee7 (this Native worktree's own branch predates the server's native-contract subsystem, so the review correctly checked git show 2a23eee7:... instead of the stale local checkout). Confirmed the href-to-media rewrite genuinely applies to completed-goal's response via the shared envelope(), confirmed no other Native code still reads .href on this model, confirmed no naming collision with the two existing MediaDescriptor structs, confirmed the updated/deleted tests are reasonable. No issues found.

ui_regression.summary: GoalsAcceptanceUITests 1/1. TrainingAcceptanceUITests: 12/13 on first pass with one flaky failure (testCorrectedEvidenceJourneys, 'app is not running', a Weight History/DEXA flow this diff never touches); reran in isolation and it passed cleanly, confirming simulator flakiness rather than a regression.

unexpected_findings: The prior report's item-3 conclusion (production photo data is fully valid, no code needed) was disproven by the Founder's own recheck. The gap: that audit verified the web-layer function's own output but never traced the additional native-contract-wide media-reference projection applied afterward, on the way to Native. Recorded here as a caution for future diagnoses of this Native production contract: always trace through envelope()/projectNativeMediaReferences(), not just the underlying domain service, since it renames keys wholesale for every native read resource.
